Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the 1959 Soviet feature as “Battle Beyond the Sun (1959), a Soviet feature,” conflating the U.S. re-edit title with the original Soviet film. The correct 1959 Soviet feature is Nebo Zovyot (The Heavens Call), which was later Americanized as Battle Beyond the Sun. This conflation leads directly to the wrong solution.
